lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple longitudinal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are distributed across the dorsal-lateral surface. The clusters are arranged in a staggered, semi-regular grid pattern with approximately 5-6 visible rows between the dorsal midline and the lower flank margin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Sub-vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity cross the flank. High-luminance spots frequently coincide with the center of these vertical bands, particularly where they intersect with the longitudinal carinae, forming a series of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges are visible on the lateral flank. These features are defined by a high-intensity luminance gradient on their superior edge and a low-intensity shadow zone on their inferior edge, running parallel to the body axis and converging towards the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains a non-uniform distribution of high-luminance spots. Approximately 8-12 distinct spots are visible, with higher spatial density observed near the posterior-basal region of the fin silhouette.
